design: 108 configurations, 12 perturbed replicas each, two perturbation families (small parameter noise plus reordered minibatches; hidden-unit permutations). Phenotype and metric were declared in the preregistration before any outcome was examined: logits on a frozen audit batch, max-norm. Target is median pairwise final functional spread; predictors are measured at step 75 of 300.
next_admissible_step: Committor and quotient Lyapunov exponent remain untested and are logically independent. Any future candidate must beat early functional spread, not merely loss, because early functional spread is now the standing baseline and it is almost free to compute.
result_1_falsifier_1_does_not_fire: Loss statistics are weak predictors of final functional agreement: |rho_s| = 0.246 for early loss and 0.51 for loss decrease, against 0.95-0.98 for the functional quantities. Basin-style measurement does add predictive value beyond loss, so preregistration falsifier 1 does not fire.
result_2_basin_coherence_is_eliminated: The elaborate coherence statistic is beaten by the simplest functional quantity. Controlling for early functional spread, basin coherence's partial correlation with the final spread is -0.18 (noise) and -0.23 (symmetry): it adds nothing and flips sign. The candidate does not earn its complexity and is dropped.
result_3_quotient_framing_survives_a_cor: On marginal Spearman the raw parameter baseline looked tied with the functional metric in the noise family (0.975 vs 0.980), which would have fired falsifier 6. That reading was wrong. Under partial correlation the parameter metric collapses to +0.21 given functional spread, while functional spread retains +0.81 given the parameter metric. The functional/quotient metric genuinely dominates, and it is not a learning-rate proxy either: partial correlation given learning rate is +0.928 in both families.
result_4_the_persistence_null_largely_ho: The dominant explanation is persistence, and it was tested rather than assumed. log10(final / early) spans only 0.31-0.35 decades, mean +0.01, with 44-46 percent of cells contracting. Final functional spread is within about a factor of two of the early value across the whole grid, while the spread itself varies over orders of magnitude. Early spread does carry a mild mean-reversion signal (corr -0.57 to -0.62 with the log ratio), but that is modest. Early functional spread is therefore a useful DIAGNOSTIC, not evidence of new basin structure.
stage: 3-4 — smallest experiment capable of falsifying basin coherence
verdict: MIXED, LEANING DEFLATIONARY. One candidate eliminated; the quotient framing survives.
what_this_costs_discovery_002: Two specific candidates of the new framework have now failed on their first tests: the escape-to-a-contracting-basin explanation of the DISCOVERY-001 failure (refuted at stage 2, 40 of 72 cells stayed above the quadratic threshold and converged anyway), and basin coherence itself (eliminated here). The framework's general premise, that trajectory- and function-level measurement beats point geometry and raw parameters, survives both.
